correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=4 the two-particle Abrams model applies by Prue–Scrimshaw theorem 3.2; its exact 0-,1-,2-cell formulas follow by disjoint-edge enumeration. The full integral top differential is injective: each spoke fiber is a cycle in a path, hence zero; after those coefficients vanish, every rim fiber is likewise a cycle in a path. Connectedness and Euler characteristic give H1 rank n+1. All signed cellular fixed-cell traces are reconstructed with edge reversals and square factor-swap signs; the table agrees with every character value, giving the representation over Q. Cyclic and full dihedral invariant arguments prove the quotient ranks. Integer boundary identities and every symmetry element are checked for n=4..14 by the embedded verifier; finite tests are corroboration, not the universal proof.

value.rationale: The natural previously studied wheel two-particle graph configuration family lacked an explicit dihedral action classification in inspected work. The theorem yields the entire rational automorphism representation for all wheel sizes, distinguishes two even-rim reflection types, and detects a sharp homological effect of symmetry reduction: two independent classes survive cyclic quotienting but no positive-degree rational homology survives the full dihedral quotient. This equivariant structure and quotient contrast are not determined by Betti numbers or a nonequivariant presentation.
